prompt:

Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.

2. Edit only this object so: The little boat's sail turned coral red. Target near x31%, y57%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The crescent in her hair became a star. Target near x73%, y5%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The cat under the left arch gained a white tail. Target near x11%, y30%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The little terracotta plant pot turned deep blue. Target near x5%, y31%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.
